service.title: 1. The service
service.text: Disponibilités lets you create occasions, share a link and enter your availability time slots to find a common time. The service is free, with no account or password: your browser is recognized by an essential cookie, created when you open the link of an occasion someone shared with you. access.qr: The device linking code (QR code) gives access to your identity in the application: do not share it.
